༄༅/ /bdud kyi g.yul las rab tu rgyal bar byed pa'i dam can rgya mtsho'i mchod sprin bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// bdud kyi g.yul las rab tu rgyal bar byed pa'i dam can rgya mtsho'i mchod sprin bzhugs so//

༄༅// "$ tshig don rnam bkra'i mchod sprin yid 'ong 'dis// mgon po'i dkyil 'khor rnam par brgyan pa'i tshe// thub chen gangs can mtsho yi 'dun sa nyid// 'dir 'ongs snyam du dpyod ldan snying ka 'dzin/ shar nas zhi ba'i mchod pa ni/ hūm̐ mchod yon bsil zer khengs pa'i ga pur sde// khrus chab sbrul gyi snying po'i rdzab ldan rdzing*// me tog 'ja' mdangs so sor phon byas pa// bdug spos yongs 'du'i drung nas 'thul ba'i ngad// mar me nyin mor byed pa'i gzugs gsar pa// byug pa yid 'ong lha yi chu bo'i rgyun// zhal zas bdud rtsi'i rtser 'thon ro brgya pa// rol mo yan lag 'bum ldan snyan pa'i sgra// re re'ang mchod pa'i yo byad ma lus pa// rab 'byams nam mkha'i khyon rnams kun bkang zhing*// thams cad tshogs pas bdog pa ma mchis pa'i// ngo mtshar kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin 'bul lo// lho nas rgyas pa'i mchod pa ni/ hūm̐ brtan g.yo bkod pa rgya mtsho'i dkyil chen por// klu dbang rin chen thams cad legs par bstar// mtho ris 'byor pa lhun du chags pa'i rtser// bkra shis lha mo brgyad kyis zlos gar sbyar// gter bum ma rmos snye ma brdal ba'i sar// mtha' bzhi rnam gnon rgyal srid sna bdun bshams// dpag bsam nags su 'dod 'jo'i ba yi khyu// phyogs las rnam rgyal rgyal mtshan bsgreng ba'i rtser// bsam 'phel mthu stobs rngom brjid bgyid pa dang*// gzhan yang srid zhi'i tshar du dngar ba yi// dbang phyug chen po'i longs spyod ma lus pa// mi zad nam mkha'i mdzod du 'bul gyis bzhes// nub nas dbang gi mchod pa ni/ hūm̐ mdzes sdug mtshan dpe'i dpal gyis 'gug byed ma// rgyud mang sgreng zhing glu sgras 'ching byed ma// rngul thigs ngad pa zhim pos dbang byed ma// zla bzhin bdud rtsi sbyin pas myos byed ma// pad can ze ba'i reg pas ltung byed ma// lus can yid 'gugs 'dod pa'i me tog mda'// sngags rgya ting 'dzin gzhu nas 'phang ba rnams// dkyil 'khor kun tu mchod pa dam par 'bul//

byang nas drag po'i mchod pa ni/ hūm̐ dgra bo mthar byed 'tshub mas dkrugs pa'i khrag /mi bzad bsgul ba klong 'khor ral pa'i byings// bsad pa'i ro tshogs lang long rgyu ba can// dmar gyi ar+ghaṃ chen po kun nas bsgreng*// nag po ha la ha la zhu ba'i chu// dug rlangs 'khrugs pas dgra bo rmongs rengs dang*// smyo 'bog brgyal dang 'chi bar byed pa'i rbas// ma lus brdzis pa'i zhabs zung rnam par bkru// mi ro las bton rgyu ma'i thag pa la// g.yul ngor sna tshogs mtshon bsnun bsad gtubs pa'i// mgo lag dbang po don lnga snod brgyus pa// dur khrod chen po'i me tog phreng bar sbrel| /ngad pa dregs pa rngams nas 'khol 'gyur ba'i// rab 'jigs du ba 'tshubs pa'i mun pa'i mthings// me stag skar mda' ltung dang rgyug byed pa'i// gdug pa'i dri can thams cad spos su sbyar// nyin mor byed pa bsad pa dmar ba'i khrag /phyogs kyi gdong la mthug por byug 'dod pa'i// ro ras sbrang chen gyis sbangs sbar ba'i me// ma lus mun la mthar byed gtum por btang*// glang chen zla bor zhe sdang mes bzhu zhing*// myos byed kyis rbad 'gram pa nas zags pa'i// gi'u wang dri bzang bung ba'i gter 'dzin pa// sim pa skyed pa'i byug pa mchog tu byas// phyogs rnams dpung bzhi'i sprin gyis bkab nas su// mtshon cha'i glog g.yo mda' rnon lce 'bab pas// bdud bzhi kha btags bla tshe srog dbugs sogs// g.yul ngor rgyal ba'i dga' ston chen por sgrig /sdig spyod rnams la chad las bzod dka' ba// ltung bas g.yo can rang dang de yi phyogs// dpa' 'khums ci bya gtol med ngu ba'i sgra// chos kyi dar chen 'phyar ba'i rol mor 'bul// de nas nang gi mchod pa ni/ hūm̐ dpag bsam shing bcud dza gad dpa' bo'i phud// pad+ma'i zil dngar rtsa brgyad yan lag stong*// lha min khrag gis sbags pa'i dri ro nus// 'chi med bdud rtsi'i khengs pa 'phrog pas mchod//

gsang ba'i mchod pa ni/ hūm̐ byang chub sems 'byongs rak+ta 'o ma'i mtsho// 'dod 'jo'i zho la 'byung ba'i rtsi khrag btab// mtshan ldan ma dang gzugs 'tshong bha ga'i rdul// bsgral ba'i dmar chen rba ru 'dzag pas mchod/ de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa ni/ hūm̐ dbyings phyug ku mud rgod pa'i ze ba'i rtser| /bsil zer byed pa lhung bas rtab rtab por// nyin byed 'od kyis bsus nas slar yang ni// bde chen 'khor lo'i mkha' la 'dzeg des mchod/// / ༈ /gtor 'bul gyi kā ri ka phyed bcas bcu gnyis pa/ hūm̐ chos kyi dbyings nas khros te 'ongs pa'i lha// rdo rje srin po mi bzad drag shul can// ye shes mgon po bya rog mtshan can la// 'khor du gur mgon phyag drug gnyan mgon zhal// las mkhan bya rog gdong can sde bzhi dang*// stag zhon a gho ra dang legs ldan che// gri gug gan+ḍi 'chang dang beng 'dzin pa// ma ning trag shad pho rgyud mgon po kun// sngags srung e ka dzā ṭi tsaṇ+ḍi ka /'dod dbang dud sol re ma ti bzhi dang*// 'bar gdong mkha' 'gro drug dang sgo mtshams ma// ma hā kā li brgyad de mo rgyud kun| /rdo rje pho nya chen mor mnga' gsol ba'i// sa gsum gnas pa'i zhing skyong mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// gu lang chen po seng gdong las gshin dang*// gza' mchog klu bdud beg rtse zhang 'on ging*| /phyogs bcu skyong ba rgyal po chen po bzhi// kun kyang rang rang bka' nyan bsam yas pa'i// sde dpung gnam sa'i khyon rnams gang gyur pa// klad du lding dang bshul du 'brang bar bcas// rab dad dwangs bas gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gyis// tshur gshegs tshur gshegs dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs// hūm̐ gting ngogs gser phye'i 'dab rdzab mi zad pa'i// dpa' bo'i dza gad rgya mtshor 'khyil ba ni// dngul dkar skyogs kyis khor yug cher gzung ba// dga' ston chen po'i slad du 'bul bar bgyi// nyams pa bdun la kha sbyar gsum phye nas// snying rjes bsgral ba'i dmar chol chen po ni// rta gdong me 'bar rgya mtsho'i chu lta bu// dga' ston=

khrag sna mi bzad brlan chags zhag gis bran// ngos bzhi sha yi rtsigs pas dmar gyur pa'i// rus pa kha zas kun gyi ba ling+ta| /dga' ston chen po'i slad du 'bul bar bgyi// hūm̐ rmad byung dgyes pa'i mchod sprin chen po 'di// sngar bcol legs par mdzad pa'i brngan lags shing*// da dung bstan pa 'dzin la 'phrin las bzhis// phyogs las rnam rgyal zhu ba'i rten lags so// gtor ma'i gsham nas cung zad phud kyis bshal ba/ hūm̐ gang gi mdzes pas mtshar byas de dang der// thub bstan ku muta thams cad 'dzum dmul zhing*// pad+ma dbang gi bka' rtags 'chang byed pa// zla ba gsar pa lta bu'i bu mo'i sde// tshur gshegs tshur gshegs bstan ma bcu gnyis po// ba ling gtor ma'i pham phabs chen po longs| /bdud rtsi sman gyi bshal chu 'di bzhes nas// dbang mtshan thig le rak+tas bran par bgyi// bod khams mun par rnyog pa'i ma rungs pa// thams cad rdzu 'phrul 'od brgyas tshar chod la| /rdzogs ldan nyin mo'i gnas skabs dang 'dra bas// thub bstan rtse dga' thams cad rgyas pa mdzod/// /
